INTRODUCTION
References are made to (i) the composite scheme document (the “Scheme Document”) jointly published 
by Galaxy Bond Holdings Limited (“ Offeror ”) and Doyen International Holdings Limited (the 
“Company”) dated 20 December 2024 in relation to, amongst others, the Proposal and the Scheme; (ii) 
the announcement jointly published by the Offeror and the Company dated 17 January 2025 in relation 
to, amongst others, the results of the Court Meeting and the EGM; and (iii) the announcement jointly 
published by the Offeror and the Company dated 25 February 2025 in relation to, amongst others, 
the sanction of the Scheme by the Court (the “ Court Sanction Announcement ”). Unless otherwise 
defined, terms used in this announcement shall have the same meanings as those defined in the Scheme 
Document.
EFFECTIVE DATE OF THE SCHEME
As set out in the Court Sanction Announcement, the Scheme was sanctioned without modification by the 
Court on Tuesday, 25 February 2025. The reduction of the issued share capital of the Company involved 
in the Scheme (the “Capital Reduction”) was also confirmed by the Court on the same day.
A sealed copy of the order of the Court made on Tuesday, 25 February 2025 sanctioning the Scheme and 
confirming the Capital Reduction under section 229 of the Companies Ordinance, and the minutes and 
the return containing particulars required under section 230 of the Companies Ordinance were registered 
by the Registrar of Companies of Hong Kong on Monday, 3 March 2025.
All of the Conditions of the Scheme as set out in the Scheme Document were fulfilled and the Scheme 
became effective on Monday, 3 March 2025.
WITHDRAWAL OF LISTING OF THE SHARES
Pursuant to the approval of the Stock Exchange, listing of the Shares on the Stock Exchange will be 
withdrawn with effect after 4:00 p.m. on Wednesday, 5 March 2025.
DESPATCH OF CHEQUES FOR CASH PAYMENT UNDER THE SCHEME
Cheques for payment of the Cancellation Price to the Remaining Scheme Shareholders will be 
despatched by ordinary post in postage pre-paid envelopes addressed to the person(s) entitled thereto 
at their respective addresses as appearing on the register of members as at the Scheme Record Date 
or, in the case of joint holders, at the address appearing on the register of members as at the Scheme 
Record Date of the joint holder whose name then stands first in the register of members in respect of the 
relevant joint holding.

3
Cheques for payment of the Cancellation Price under the Scheme will be despatched to the Remaining 
Scheme Shareholders as soon as possible but in any event on or before Wednesday, 12 March 2025.
Cheques shall be posted at the risk of the person(s) entitled thereto and none of the Offeror, the 
Company, Somerley, the Independent Financial Adviser and the Company’s share registrar and their 
respective directors, employees, officers, agents, advisers, associates and affiliates and any other persons 
involved in the Proposal shall be responsible for any loss or delay in transmission.
